name: /prioritize
description: Reorder TODO.md by strategic importance through guided questions

steps.context: Read .exocortex/TODO.md. Show current Ready items. Ask 5 strategic questions one at a time: 1) What blocks other work? 2) Highest business value? 3) Most urgent? 4) Dependencies between items? 5) Proposed final order with reasons. Iterate if user disagrees.
Show proposed new TODO.md order. Ask 'Does this order feel right?' Only rewrite the Ready section of TODO.md after explicit approval. Never auto-write.
